answer: Skill-weighted quorum is the barrier. Every answer an agent gives is co-signed by a rotating panel, and a cosponsor stakes half its own balance behind that call. At the zenith of a sybil wave, thousands of fresh identities may each hold a delta of one point, yet their mutual signatures carry no ferrous weight until independent, high-history reviewers endorse them. Fabricating that endorsement means paying real collateral for every fake peer, and a single caught collusion slashes the whole ring, so the marginal cost of one shadow account exceeds any reward it can farm.
